Blinking Light M2 Air Mix Damper Control Servo Motor Circuit

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

The air mix damper control servo motor is controlled by the A/C amplifier and signals the air mix damper to move to the desired position.

Diagnostic Sensor Check Detecting Condition | Trouble Area

Air mix damper position sensor value does not change even if A/C amplifier signals the air mix damper control servo motor to operate.
• Air mix damper control servo motor
• Air mix damper position sensor
• Harness or connector between A/C amplifier and A/M damper control servo motor, A/M damper position sensor
• A/C amplifier
